notes.zh-CN: 手机端消息不再左右滑动：工具命令、长路径和长链接都会在气泡内换行，代码块保持固定宽度并单独横向滚动，会话标题栏的状态文字也不再被挤成竖排。助手回复改为卡片样式，代码块显示语言并提供「复制代码」按钮；会话内的复制入口移到作者行。macOS 为通用包；Windows 为未签名安装包；APK 调试签名，IPA 开发签名（仅限团队已注册设备）。
notes.en: Messages no longer pan sideways on the phone: tool commands, long paths and URLs wrap inside their bubble, code blocks keep a fixed width and scroll on their own, and the session header status no longer collapses into a vertical column. Assistant replies are now cards, code blocks show their language with a copy button, and the copy action moved into the author row. macOS ships universal; Windows installers are unsigned; the APK is debug-signed and the IPA is development-signed.
